dedupe_keys.name: sdg indicator 11 7 1 urban public space availability and access 2023 release sedac

description: Part of SEDAC's SDG indicators collection, this 2023 release estimates UN indicator 11.7.1, the average share of a city's built-up area that is open space for public use for all, for 8,873 urban centres in 180 countries. The indicator combines the share of OpenStreetMap public space within each urban centre with the share of WorldPop gridded population living within 400 metres of open public space, with cities delineated by the JRC's GHS Urban Centre Database. Coverage: global, for 2015 to 2022. Access: free download through NASA Earthdata, version 2023.00, DOI 10.7927/eavc-4k45. Licence: shared without restriction under EOSDIS data use and citation guidance. Caveats: results depend on how completely OpenStreetMap maps public space in each city, which varies widely, and the release is a single 2023 edition. Simulation uses: comparing public space supply and walking access between cities, and as a baseline for heat refuge and green space adaptation planning. Related records: the UN-Habitat open spaces and green areas data, OpenStreetMap parks and the OpenspaceGlobal megacity map.
